meta.title: String literal completions right after quote
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#52676 (Exclude literal completions after closing quote and JSX attribute location), 0e357f510b, 2023-02-28; git tag --contains: first in v5.1-beta / v5.1.3
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@5.0.4 (2023-04-07) and typescript@5.1.3 (2023-06-01), both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.2 (the latest wrapper release before 5.1.3), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session.
meta.notes: The fix stops offering literal completions right after a closing quote, so a post-fix list without the literal is 'absent' (missing: absent).

settings_note: The issue names no settings (playground defaults); no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.note: the comment line is part of the issue's code

repro.steps: Open index.ts and trigger suggestions right after the last quote of "const a: 'a' = ''" (line 2, character 17). Reported: the string literal completion 'a' is offered; expected: no string literal completions there. Accepting it appends a second string literal after the closing quote. Probe: accept the offered literal item; the edited text must not have a parse error the original did not have. No such item offered counts as absent.
